nom: ANUA Rice Enzyme Brightening Cleansing Powder

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin mostly describe brighter, softer skin without stripping, sometimes crediting the ceramides, but a recurring minority instead report tightness or a drier, less-hydrated feel after use despite the product's hydrating claims.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin are largely positive about the gentleness, fragrance-free formula and lack of irritation, including on rosacea-prone skin, though a minority report a reaction ranging from delayed peeling to a severe burning rash.
segments.combination: The few reviewers with combination skin report the cleanser left their skin hydrated and brighter without dryness, even during a drier seasonal stretch.
segments.mature: The one reviewer identifying mature skin found it gentle with no dryness or tightness, alongside visible smoothing and brightening.

concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers who mention dryness say the cleanser left skin hydrated, soft and not stripped, crediting the ceramide content. Several others describe the opposite — a tight, dehydrated feel that didn't match the product's hydrating claims — and note they needed a moisturizer applied right after to avoid dryness.
concerns.redness: The large majority report no redness or irritation, including several with sensitive skin. Against this, one reviewer developed a painful burning rash within days of first use, and another got recurring red blotches on repeated use despite otherwise liking the product.
concerns.barrier: Multiple reviewers say normal use doesn't strip or disrupt the skin barrier. One reviewer who used it daily for a week instead reports light irritation bumps appearing by day four and warns against daily use to avoid disrupting the moisture barrier.
concerns.spots: Reviewers tracking dark spots, hyperpigmentation or post-acne marks report visible fading and a more even tone with regular or mask-style use; none describe spots worsening.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers with acne-prone, fungal-acne-prone, or blackhead-prone skin generally report no new breakouts and describe the cleanser as gentler than others they've tried, with visible improvement in pores and blackheads after about a week. One reviewer managing active acne flares instead reports light irritation bumps after daily use and recommends using it less often.

aspects.libelle: Slimy, sticky wet texture puts some off
Residue can be hard to rinse
Tricky to dose the right amount

extraits.texte: Beware if you have sensitive skin! Seriously burned my face and neck. Washed my face and neck with this stuff and got a rash on my face and neck that burned really bad. After 2 days of being inflamed and burning, my skin turned rough and leathery feeling wherever the rash was and still burns. I normally don't leave negative reviews but I also never had my skin react like this to a product before. Didn't want anyone else to experience this problem. Really has been quite painful so I recommend you use with caution if used at all.

Korean skincare has been making its way around and I just had to try it out for myself. Anua is not a new brand to my skincare collection. I absolutely adore their cleaning oil and niacinamide serum. I've had amazing results with those products in particular. The rice enzyme brightening cleansing powder however, was a bit disappointing. I do think the aspect of having to mix the powder and water is a cool concept but it can get messy and too much powder can be poured out. When I'm in a rush I just want a one and done type of product. I did notice how soft my skin was when using the cleansing powder and it claims to be hydrating and non drying but that wasn't my experience. I have dry acne prone skin and my skin felt tight. It is fragrance free which I could appreciate but I would pass this cleansing powder up and stick to my orginal cleansing liquid.

It's out with the old and in with the new with this one. This compact product is glowness on the go! I love how the packaging is perfect for travel. I tend to overindulge when it comes to cleansing but a little bit of powder goes a long way. It emulsifies on impact and the product reminds me of dermalogica's microfoliant except the particles are sized bigger and the texture can feel a little bit more grainy on impact like a scrub. Making it the perfect dupe for a $60 product. Even though it is the same price as Dermalogica's Microfoliant mini, you are still getting more powder with Anua. From the first use, my skin immideately looked less dull. I have been dealing with texture, acne flares, and added dryness thanks to the season, but using this cleanser allowed the rest of my products absorb easier. When pairing powder with the hydrating barrier serum I noticed an acne scar I had has been slowing fading. By adding an oil cleanser, radiance masks like Tata Harper or detox masks like Malin + Goetz, moisturizer i.e. La Roche Posay, and a sunscreen when needed; my skin has evened out significantly. I usually would add an undereye retinol alternative treatment to lighten the dark circles but I don't necessarily need it with this regimen. I would recommend not using this product every day to avoid overexfoilating and overcleansing because it can disrupt your moisture barrier. extraits.titre: Wanted to love but not for me
extraits.texte: As a beauty enthusiast, I've been a big fan on Korean skincare for years now. But never having tried a powder cleanser before I was so excited to try the Rice Enzyme Brightening Cleansing Powder by ANUA. Formulated with rice water and packed with ceramides, this multipurpose cleanser promises to make your skin more balanced and bright. One of the things that stood out most to me is you can use it one of two ways; add the powder with water to create a cleansing foam or create a paste with water to use as a mask. My initial impression was positive; I love that a little bit of product goes a long way. Although there is a little trial and error at first because using too much of the powder can make it a little more difficult to rinse off. I was definitely glad I was in the shower the first time I used it. Once I rinsed it off my skin felt deeply cleansed but so incredibly moisturized. I wasn't expecting that with clay being a main ingredient of the powder! However, there must be an ingredient that doesn't agree with me because within 20 minutes my skin had big red blotches. I tried it several more times after just in case it was user error and maybe I didn't rinse well enough because other than the blotches my skin felt SO GOOD after using it but unfortunately had the same experience each time. Everyone's skin is different so I would still recommend the cleanser to anyone looking for brighter more radiant skin. *this review was collected as part of a promotion

First, let's talk about the texture. This powder transforms into a silky, creamy foam when mixed with water. It feels luxurious on the skin, almost like a mini spa treatment. The rice enzymes are incredibly fine, so the exfoliation is gentle—perfect for my sensitive skin. Unlike harsher scrubs, this didn't leave me red or irritated. After just one use, my skin felt smoother and looked brighter. Over the course of a week, I noticed my complexion appearing more even, and my dark spots were less noticeable. Plus, it doesn't strip my skin or leave it feeling tight, which is a must for me. Another thing I love is how clean the ingredients feel. The product has no overwhelming fragrance and doesn't rely on harsh chemicals to deliver results. It's effective while still being gentle, making it a great choice for daily use. If I had to nitpick, I'd say it can be a bit messy if you're in a rush (powder products always are), but the results make it worth the minor inconvenience. This produce has earned a permanent spot in my skincare routine, especially for days when my skin needs a little extra TLC.

I'm absolutely loving the ANUA Rice Enzyme Brightening Cleansing Powder! As a beauty enthusiast, I'm always on the lookout for products that deliver on their promises, and this one certainly does. This gentle, non-foaming powder cleanser effectively removes dirt and impurities while brightening and evening out my skin tone. I've noticed a significant reduction in hyperpigmentation and a more radiant complexion overall. The rice enzyme and licorice extract ingredients work synergistically to provide a deep cleanse without stripping my skin of its natural oils. I was impressed to find that ANUA's formula is free from harsh chemicals, artificial fragrances, and dyes, making it perfect for sensitive skin types. The packaging is also eco-friendly and travel-friendly, which is a big plus in my book!

I got this product in exchange of my honest review. My first time trying this brand and I am obsessed. I have combination skin but during fall/winter my skin gets drier. This cleanser cleanse my skin without leaving it dry. My skin feels hydrated and beautiful. I love that in comes in a powder formula because it helps to gently exfoliate the skin which is a plus in a cleanser. I love that it has rice enzyme because I feel like it helps to hydrate and soothe the skin. I use this cleanser morning and night and my skin looks brighter and beautiful. I love k beauty brands. I will definitely repurchase this cleanser. I love the packaging it's super easy to use and travel. I have large pores and blackheads and this cleanser has definitely helped my skin a lot. I have only use this cleanser for about a week and I can already see a difference in my skin.
